instructions.title: 📖 How to Use This App
instructions.mobile_sidebar: 📱 **Mobile users:** Tap the arrow in the top-left corner to expand the sidebar and access all controls
instructions.step1: Choose **Single Ticker** or **Portfolio** at the top of the sidebar
instructions.step2: Select the start and end dates for your backtest period
instructions.step3: Pick a trading strategy and adjust its parameters (MA periods, RSI thresholds, investment amounts, etc.)
instructions.step4: Optionally set slippage/fees in basis points per trade
instructions.step5: Click **Run Strategy** to load data and view results
instructions.single_step1: Enter one stock ticker (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, TSLA)
instructions.single_step2: All five strategies are available, including **New Car vs. Investing** — a what-if scenario that invests your car down payment and loan payments instead of buying a vehicle
instructions.portfolio_step1: Enter two or more tickers, separated by commas or new lines (e.g., `AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL`)
instructions.portfolio_step2: Set each ticker's allocation weight — weights must sum to **100%**. Use **Auto Equal Weights** to split evenly; weights auto-rebalance when you add or remove tickers
instructions.portfolio_step3: For Buy & Hold, Moving Average Crossover, and RSI: enter **Total Portfolio Capital** — each ticker receives its weight share of that amount
instructions.portfolio_step4: Dollar Cost Averaging uses your per-purchase amount and buy frequency; capital is scaled by each ticker's weight
instructions.portfolio_step5: **New Car vs. Investing** is not available in portfolio mode (single-asset scenario only)
instructions.portfolio_note: If a ticker fails to load, it is skipped and remaining weights are renormalized. A warning shows which tickers were skipped and the effective weights used.
instructions.us_stocks: US Stocks: Enter the ticker directly (e.g., `AAPL` for Apple, `GOOGL` for Google, `MSFT` for Microsoft)
instructions.non_us_stocks: Non-US Stocks: Add a country code suffix after the ticker:
instructions.cn_stocks: Chinese stocks: Add `.SS` for Shanghai or `.SZ` for Shenzhen (e.g., `600519.SS` for Kweichow Moutai, `000858.SZ` for Wuliangye)
instructions.hk_stocks: Hong Kong stocks: Add `.HK` (e.g., `0700.HK` for Tencent, `0005.HK` for HSBC)
instructions.sg_stocks: Singapore stocks: Add `.SI` (e.g., `D05.SI` for DBS Bank, `O39.SI` for OCBC)
instructions.jp_stocks: Japanese stocks: Add `.T` (e.g., `7203.T` for Toyota, `6758.T` for Sony)
instructions.crypto: ₿ Cryptocurrencies: Use the crypto symbol followed by your preferred currency (e.g., `BTC-USD` for Bitcoin, `ETH-USD` for Ethereum, `BTC-EUR` for Bitcoin in Euros)
instructions.not_sure: Not sure? Check [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com) to find the correct ticker symbol
instructions.price_chart: Price Chart: Stock price with buy/sell signal markers
instructions.equity_curve: Equity Curve: Your strategy vs. a benchmark (buy & hold, SPY DCA, or car depreciation for New Car)
instructions.metrics: Metrics: Total return, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, and benchmark comparison
instructions.trades_table: Trades Table: Entry/exit dates, costs, P/L, and return % for each round trip
instructions.portfolio_equity: Portfolio Equity Curve: Weighted blend of all tickers vs. SPY buy & hold
instructions.per_ticker_equity: Per-Ticker Equity Curves: Individual strategy performance for each holding (labeled with weight %)
instructions.portfolio_metrics: Portfolio Metrics: Combined return, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, plus dollar invested/value/gain
instructions.portfolio_trades: Trades Table: All trades across tickers with a filter to show specific symbols
instructions.portfolio_detail: Per-Ticker Breakdown: Expandable table with weight, dollar allocation, return, Sharpe, max drawdown, and data source per ticker
